title: working on a space colony simulator, (that's really my excuse to make a huge procedural gravity sim) what do you think?
author: DavesGames123
selftext: i'm dave, and this is my game Stella Nova! \[ [davesgames.io](http://davesgames.io) \] I'm super excited about it and very passionate about game developement. I'd love to get your feedback on the visual style and the overall flow of the game, please feel free to ask questions!

comments.author: Felfedezni
comments.body: Is there a demo or beta?

replies.author: DavesGames123
replies.body:
it's coming extremely soon! our discord is the best place to be to have an eye out for it in the meantime, check my site for the link!

what other kind of games do you play?

comments.author: EnigmaticSloth_30
comments.body:
OMG this looks really interesting!  
I'm also doing the similar thing recently, but ur graphic is much better!  
Nice work!

replies.author: DavesGames123
replies.body:
it looks pretty unique what you're working on actually! i like how much it reminds me of stellaris. graphics are really just gravy, engaging gameplay is really where it's at!

what are your plans for your project in the future?

replies.author: EnigmaticSloth_30
replies.body:
Actually my project is inspired by Stellaris!!
The actual problem is that I can’t play it wherever I want.
So the goal of my work is to develop a Stellaris-like game on iOS, running a 1000+ stars Galaxy on my own phone.

replies.author: DavesGames123
replies.body:
that sounds stellar! no pun intended ;)

you should totally join our discord to stay in touch! [davesgames.io](http://davesgames.io) should have everything you need. I think your vision sounds really cool and I'm getting a bunch of developers together there :)

replies.author: EnigmaticSloth_30
replies.body:
Sure! I'll look into it!  
btw I just built this game on my iPhone14, and it works pretty well!!! Now I have a Galaxy with 1000+ stars in my phone! My dream finally comes true.

https://i.redd.it/1yizvzqxswtg1.gif

comments.author: Fairway3Games
comments.body: I have also started down this path: [https://fairway3games.com/type-iii](https://fairway3games.com/type-iii) for a game idea. yours is current way more intense than mine. I was like: could I put a light game in space: build ships, send them to things, extract resources, build more ships, build interstellar gates, send ships to other stars.

comments.author: SplinterOfChaos
comments.body:
I'm a sucker for physics simulations and I was curious how the spiral coming out of Homeworld in your trailer worked. If they're asteroids, isn't the homeworld cooked? Could they be something else?

Well, it'd be nice if the menus on the right had just a slightly higher contrast because I can't read this.
